newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX steady, holding overnight gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent, NYMEX steady, holding overnight gains.

text.p: Crude futures in Asia were steady in late trading on Thursday, with Brent reinforcing London's gains and NYMEX turning level after trading slightly down earlier.
February Brent futures trading on SIMEX last traded at $24.80 per barrel, in line with London's settlement which rose 21 cents overnight.
NYMEX February crude, trading on the ACCESS system, last traded at $26.63, up one cent from New York and an intraday high. Earlier Thursday it was down three cents.
Brokers said the focus was firmly back on the weather after the U.S. and London shrugged off the API data to rally in late trading on Wednesday.
Independent Weather Services Corp was forecasting mostly below average temperatures in the U.S. northeast over the next six to 10 days. Europe continues to suffer from a severe cold snap.
The weather boosted heating oil, which extended the 0.94 cent New York gains by another 0.22 cent to last trade on ACCESS at 73.65 cents per gallon.
